author: Vox
description:
Should Kamala Harris run for president again in 2028? At the Juneteenth Family Fest Charleston, Vox’s Astead Herndon polled attendees on whether the former vice president should give the presidency another shot. Their answers revealed a mix of hope, skepticism, and bigger questions about women in leadership and whether America is ready.

Get the results of our poll in the full episode, publishing this Saturday on Vox's YouTube channel.
